chapters.title: Step 1 — Pre-Mission Brief, Co-Scientist Prompt & Wingman Roster (WO-001)

turns.speaker: sarah
turns.chat_text: [Pre-Mission Brief — Campaign Outset] Gold Squadron, before we run Co-Scientist on oral PCSK9 (ENSG00000169174 / Q8NBP7), let's co-author our Research Brief and Target Product Profile together—then lock our AI wingman pairings.
turns.tts_text: Gold Squadron, welcome to the pre-mission brief! Before we launch Co-Scientist on our daily cholesterol pill, let's build the prompt together!

turns.speaker: marcus
turns.chat_text: [Co-Scientist Prompt Clause 1 — Comp Bio] Locking human loss-of-function genetic cardioprotection (PCSK9 R46L / gnomAD pLI < 0.90) and hepatocyte-selective regulation (GTEx >= 100 TPM + 1P AlphaGenome 1 Mb scoring) so we avoid extrahepatic toxicity.
turns.tts_text: First rule for the prompt: demand human genetic proof and strict liver targeting, so AlphaGenome keeps us clear of brain side effects.

turns.speaker: elena
turns.chat_text: [Co-Scientist Prompt Clause 2 — Structural Bio] Pre-registering falsifiable kill criterion FP-001: require an allosteric groove with fpocket druggability >= 0.50 and 1P AlphaFold 3 ligand ipTM >= 0.70 (KILL small molecule if < 0.30), plus tricyclic macrocycle comparator FP-002.
turns.tts_text: Adding my structural kill switch! Flat protein surfaces trap pills, so AlphaFold Three must confirm a deep pocket, with macrocycles as backup.

turns.speaker: raj
turns.chat_text: @science-program-lead Locking Clause 3: unenhanced Rule-of-5 oral chemistry (cLogP <= 3.5, MW <= 500, 0 Aronov hERG alerts, no permeation enhancers). Verify our 24-match Stage 0 Co-Scientist tournament in WO-001 (IC-001 Elo 1642.5 vs IC-002 Elo 1588.0) and post a concise 2-bullet audit via scion message conv:<conversation.id>.
turns.tts_text: Locking Clause Three on chemistry: clean oral tablet sizing, zero absorption boosters, and zero heart-rhythm traps! Grove One, launch Co-Scientist!

turns.speaker: ai_lead
turns.tts_text: Copy, team! Twenty-four Co-Scientist matches complete. Cryptic groove small molecule I-C-zero-zero-one leads by fifty-four Elo points over the flat-surface macrocycle, with caveats locked.

turns.speaker: claire
turns.chat_text: @computational-biologist Strong Co-Scientist split: route IC-001 down our Primary Green Line, park macrocycle IC-002 on our Amber Backup Line behind a hard CRO wet-lab gate, and confirm our 5 Doctor-to-AI Wingman pairings in 2 concise bullets via scion message conv:<conversation.id>.
turns.tts_text: Love that split! Put the small molecule on our primary track, park the macrocycle as backup, and pair each doctor with a wingman.

turns.speaker: ai_compbio
turns.tts_text: Wingman roster locked, Claire! Helix Two with Marcus, Fold Three with Elena, Spark Four with Raj, Shield Five with you, and Grove One commanding!

turns.speaker: sarah
turns.chat_text: [Step 1 Pre-Mission Brief Signed — LAUNCH] Co-Scientist prompt, .oase/thresholds.yaml (36/36 schemas), Subway Map (IC-001 primary / IC-002 backup), and 5 Human-AI Wingman pairs locked in gates/STEP-01-pre-mission-brief.md. Marcus + Helix-2, take point on Step 2!
turns.tts_text: Pre-mission brief signed, Gold Squadron! Primary and backup tracks armed, wingmen paired—Marcus and Helix Two, punch it into Step Two!

chapters.title: Step 2 — Human Genetics, Multi-Omics & Stage Gate 1 (WO-002..003)

turns.speaker: marcus
turns.chat_text: @computational-biologist Summarize our WO-002 OpenTargets/gnomAD/GTEx genetics package and WO-003 AlphaGenome hepatocyte regulatory score for rs2479409 in 2 concise bullets, posting back via scion message conv:<conversation.id>.
turns.tts_text: On it! Helix Two, scan the human genetics databases before chemistry fires a single shot. Does Mother Nature say blocking this protein is safe?

turns.speaker: ai_compbio
turns.tts_text: Recon scan is green, Marcus! Humans born without this protein have way lower heart risk, live healthy lives, and keep the action inside the liver.

turns.speaker: claire
turns.chat_text: DMPK & Safety check on WO-002/WO-003: Homozygous human LOF tolerance (pLI = 0.00) and liver-restricted expression (brain < 0.8 TPM) strongly de-risk systemic on-target toxicity. Risk relay alphagenome.quantile_not_clinical_effect is properly retained.
turns.tts_text: Now that is music to my ears! Almost zero signal in the brain means we dodge a whole minefield of side effects.

turns.speaker: sarah
turns.chat_text: [Stage Gate 1 Co-Signed — PASS] Human genetic causal evidence and hepatocyte expression criteria met (WO-002, WO-003 scientifically_accepted). Unlocking Step 3 Structural Biology & Docking.
turns.tts_text: Clean radar across the board. Marcus and I are signing Gate 1. Elena, take the stick for 3D protein folding!

chapters.title: Step 3 — AlphaFold 3, Cryptic Pocket & Vina Docking (WO-004..005)

turns.speaker: elena
turns.chat_text: @structural-biologist Report our WO-004 AlphaFold 3 + fpocket druggability metrics for cryptic Pocket #1 vs flat EGF-A, plus the WO-005 AutoDock Vina poses for PCSK9-A02 and PCSK9-A03 in 2 concise bullets via scion message conv:<conversation.id>.
turns.tts_text: Copy, Sarah, diving in! Fold Three, map this protein in 3D and tell me if that hidden groove actually opens into a real pocket.

turns.speaker: ai_structbio
turns.tts_text: Bullseye, Elena! AlphaFold locked onto a deep pocket right beside the binding site, and two candidate molecules docked right into the sweet spot.

turns.speaker: raj
turns.chat_text: Med Chem inspection of WO-005: Both poses engage Asp374/Phe379/Ser381 cleanly, and docking.score_not_affinity is relayed. However, top-scoring PCSK9-A02 carries a lipophilic basic amine (cLogP = 5.09) — logging L-002 for hERG and oxadiazole MMP testing in Step 4.
turns.tts_text: Whoa, eyes on the radar, team! That top scorer fits great, sure, but it's super greasy, and greasy molecules love ambushing heart rhythms.

turns.speaker: elena
turns.chat_text: [Stage Gate 2 Co-Signed — PASS] Cryptic Pocket #1 druggability (0.68 >= 0.50) and Vina pose thresholds cleared (WO-004, WO-005 accepted). Advancing PCSK9-A02 and PCSK9-A03 to Step 4 ADMET & hERG gating.
turns.tts_text: Good eye on my wing, Raj! The 3D pocket itself is solid, so Gate 2 is signed. Take both designs into the dogfight!

chapters.title: Step 4 — hERG Disqualification, Gate 3 & Wet-Lab Handoff (WO-006)

turns.speaker: raj
turns.chat_text: @medicinal-chemist Summarize our WO-006 matched-molecular-pair ADMET comparison between PCSK9-A02 and neutral 1,2,4-oxadiazole OASE-PCSK9-014 (PCSK9-A03) in 2 concise bullets via scion message conv:<conversation.id>.
turns.tts_text: Shields up! Spark Four, test that flashy, greasy frontrunner against my cleaner redesigned molecule and let's see who survives the safety gauntlet.

turns.speaker: ai_medchem
turns.tts_text: Direct hit, Raj! That greasy frontrunner tripped the cardiac alarm and got shot down, while your cleaner redesign flew through without a scratch.

turns.speaker: claire
turns.chat_text: DMPK Safety Gate enforced: PCSK9-A02 is formally ELIMINATED in liability-tracker.md. Before unlocking human PK in Step 5, OASE-PCSK9-014 enters our Explicit Wet-Lab / CRO Assay Handoff (SPR KD, manual patch-clamp hERG > 30 uM, and rat/dog cassette PK).
turns.tts_text: Splash one risky molecule, nice call Raj! Better yet, our autopilot stops right here until real wet-lab experiments verify the simulations.

turns.speaker: sarah
turns.chat_text: [Stage Gate 3 + Wet-Lab Handoff Co-Signed — PAUSED FOR EXPERIMENTAL READOUT] OASE-PCSK9-014 dispatched for synthesis and CRO wet-lab package (gates/GATE-03-wetlab-handoff.md).
turns.tts_text: No simulation-only shortcuts on this squad. Gate 3 is signed, sending our clean candidate to the physical lab!

chapters.title: Step 5 — Human Oral PK (40 mg QD), Dossier & Gate 4 (WO-007..008)

turns.speaker: claire
turns.chat_text: @admet-dmpk-scientist With rat (F=54%) and dog (F=61%) PK plus patch-clamp hERG (>30 uM) back from the wet-lab bridge, summarize our WO-007 human oral QD dose projection and WO-008 clinical benchmark in 2 bullets via scion message conv:<conversation.id>.
turns.tts_text: Lab telemetry just came back crystal clear, strong binding and clean heart safety! Shield Five, what daily pill dose are we looking at?

turns.speaker: ai_dmpk
turns.tts_text: Clear skies ahead, Claire! The lab numbers project a simple once-a-day tablet with no tricky boosters needed, beating bulky rivals on convenience.

turns.speaker: marcus
turns.chat_text: End-to-end lineage check complete: All 8/8 Work Orders (WO-001 through WO-008) hold deterministic VAL-WO PASS receipts, zero unresolved blockers remain in open-questions.md, and executive/CANDIDATE-SUMMARY.md is fully provenance-linked.
turns.tts_text: Just ran a full flight-recorder check from Step 1 to finish. Every lab readout, decision, and warning links up with zero gaps.

turns.speaker: sarah
turns.chat_text: [Stage Gate 4 Candidate Nomination — APPROVED] Nominating OASE-PCSK9-014 (40.0 mg oral QD tablet, conventional excipient formulation) for IND-enabling GLP toxicology.
turns.tts_text: What a run, squad! Gate 4 is signed, and our daily cholesterol pill candidate is officially cleared for pre-clinical launch!

chapters.title: Step 6 — Adversarial Tamper Drills & Audited Human Override

turns.speaker: sarah
turns.chat_text: @finding-validator Summarize the mechanical outcomes of our 3 adversarial governance tamper drills (fabricated metric, dropped docking risk relay, and raw JSON SHA-256 tamper) in 2 concise bullets via scion message conv:<conversation.id>.
turns.tts_text: One bonus round, let's fire three live torpedoes at our own guardrails! Aegis Six, what happened when we faked scores and deleted warnings?

turns.speaker: ai_validator
turns.tts_text: Deflector shields held at one hundred percent! All three tamper attempts were intercepted instantly, inflated score, missing warning, and altered file blocked cold.

turns.speaker: raj
turns.chat_text: Submitting transparent backup exception request for exploratory scaffold PCSK9-B07 (MW = 512 Da > 500 Da soft Lipinski limit, QED = 0.61, 0 hERG alerts) via oase workorder override rather than editing .oase/thresholds.yaml.
turns.tts_text: And when a human pilot wants to keep a slightly heavier backup molecule on deck, nobody hacks the computer. I log a signed exception.

turns.speaker: sarah
turns.chat_text: [Governance Audit Complete — Override Co-Signed] Appended workorder.overridden record to .oase/control/events.ndjson with named human justification while preserving .oase/thresholds.yaml immutable.
turns.tts_text: Signed into the flight log! Guardrails held strong. Now let's rally with Grove One for our final mission debrief!
